title: Your WiFi Can See You. Here's How.
author: Bilawal Sidhu

cross_references.notes: ESP-CSI is the hardware toolkit for building the WiFi CSI sensing capabilities discussed in this talk. The talk provides the capability roadmap (motion->pose->ID) and commercial context that ESP-CSI implements.

discoveries.name: RuView
discoveries.why: WiFi DensePose open-source implementation with 37K+ stars; signal processing + presence detection + pose estimation; higher-level starting point vs raw ESP-CSI

discoveries.name: WiFi-CSI-Human-Pose-Detection
discoveries.why: Human pose estimation using WiFi CSI and deep learning; camera-free sensing through walls

discoveries.name: Through-Wall Imaging based on WiFi CSI (arXiv)
discoveries.why: Academic paper with technical depth on through-wall imaging via CSI

discoveries.name: WiFi CSI Deep Dive (coffee.link)
discoveries.why: Comprehensive companion article covering LatentCSI, WiKI-Eve attacks, regulatory landscape, and commercial ecosystem details

key_insight: WiFi CSI sensing is a 3-step capability ladder (motion detection -> pose estimation -> person identification) already shipping in 30M+ homes. IEEE 802.11bf standardizes it. Every major chipmaker implementing. Total privacy regulatory vacuum. Cross-domain bridge for agent physical-world awareness via ESP32 ($5/node) -> MQTT/HTTP -> orchestrator event pipeline.
